user.title: Filament Ledger
user.description: Track how much filament you actually have left, using double-entry bookkeeping instead of guesswork. Everything here can be changed later.

data.anomaly_threshold: Flag a reconciliation this far off (%)
data.auto_mount_on_rfid: Mount spools automatically on RFID detection

data_description.default_opening_weight: What a fresh spool holds. Bambu spools are 1000 g.
data_description.default_core_weight: The bare reel, without filament. A kitchen scale weighs the whole spool, so the ledger subtracts this for you. Bambu reels are about 250 g.
data_description.anomaly_threshold: When the scale disagrees with the ledger by more than this, something upstream is systematically wrong and worth a look.
data_description.auto_mount_on_rfid: When the printer reads a known tag, record that spool as mounted in that slot. Turn off if you load registered spools briefly and want their recorded locations left alone.

abort.already_configured: Filament Ledger is already set up. One inventory is the point.

data.anomaly_threshold: Flag a reconciliation this far off (%)
data.auto_mount_on_rfid: Mount spools automatically on RFID detection

register_spool.name: Register spool
register_spool.description: Add a spool to the inventory. It is born with an opening balance movement — there is no such thing as a balance without an entry that explains it.

colour.name: Colour
colour.description: RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, with or without a leading #.

core_weight.name: Empty spool weight
core_weight.description: The bare reel. Used to turn a scale reading into filament mass.

label.name: Label
label.description: Your own name for this spool.

tag_uid.name: RFID tag
tag_uid.description: Optional. A Bambu tag identifies a batch, not a spool.

confirm_duplicate_tag.name: Allow duplicate tag
confirm_duplicate_tag.description: Two spools from the same batch share a tag. Legal, but it has to be deliberate.

reconcile_spool.name: Weigh spool
reconcile_spool.description: Correct a balance against a physical measurement. The difference is recorded as a movement, so the drift stays visible instead of being silently absorbed.

includes_core.name: Includes the reel
includes_core.description: On if you weighed the whole spool.

discard_filament.name: Discard filament
discard_filament.description: Record filament thrown away — a whole spool, or part of one.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The whole spool, or a partial amount.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Required. Six months from now nobody remembers.

adjust_spool.name: Adjust spool
adjust_spool.description: A free-form correction for cases the specific operations do not cover.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Required. An unexplained adjustment is indistinguishable from a bug.

mount_spool.name: Mount spool
mount_spool.description: Put a spool in an AMS slot. Records no movement — moving a spool consumes no filament.

unmount_spool.name: Unmount spool
unmount_spool.description: Return a spool to storage. Records no movement.

approve_review.name: Approve review
approve_review.description: Confirm what an interrupted print consumed. Only approval writes to the ledger — your numbers always win over the estimate.

amounts.name: Corrected amounts
amounts.description: Grams keyed by slot number — for example, slot 1 to 28.4. Overrides the estimate for the slots you name.

assign.name: Spool assignments
assign.description: Spool id keyed by slot number — for example, slot 3 to a spool id. Resolves a slot the review recorded without a spool.

note.name: Note
note.description: Anything worth remembering about the decision.

dismiss_review.name: Dismiss review
dismiss_review.description: Resolve a review without recording consumption. A recorded decision, not a deletion.

note.name: Note
note.description: Why nothing is recorded — a first-layer failure, a false positive.

sync_trays.name: Sync with printer
sync_trays.description: Re-read every AMS tray and reconcile the ledger with what the printer reports right now. Known tags mount their spools, unknown tags are reported, and nothing is invented. The same pass runs automatically at startup.
